_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. `LowpolyMutation` is a semio-NATIVE vocabulary carried in `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio`, so no oracle is registered and the decision below records what stands in for one.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: No third-party library reads or writes semio's own `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio` envelope, and none is authoritative over `LowpolyMutation` — a vocabulary over a document with exactly TWO top-level fields, `schema` and an id-keyed `objects` list whose members each carry an INDEX-keyed, anonymous `paintLayers` sub-collection. That two-level addressing is the whole point of the vocabulary and it is this subset's own specification, not a fact an external mesh or scene library could confirm or refute. Confidence comes instead from the committed specification vectors under `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/<kind>/🧪️tests/<fixture>/` — one handcrafted `(before, mutation, diff, outcome, after)` quintet per kind, already unit-tested inside the production crate — replayed end-to-end through the test platform here, plus two metamorphic laws asserted in role: observability (a kind must move the compared projection) and footprint completeness (`before` and `after` may differ on exactly the fields the committed diff declares, which is the precondition that makes the mutation undoable at all).
